summary: Two climbers from Manitou Springs and Fort Collins were stranded near the top of Redgarden Wall at dusk, unsure of the descent; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group climbed the East Slabs and assisted them down. Uninjured.
notes: ANAC 2022 edition (Pub 2022); one of two stranding incidents in same article; incident date Dec 4 per article.
